title: fix(metadata, metadata-protocol, core)!: the bare read and removal of an action name judge the loaders' slots beside the registry's, tell the platform's package-less item from the environment's, and remove what the bare read answers (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuS8SPP6sDywXCiLYGv5CHC7)_ domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTYAmRpCGWdmGZSW5G ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：不带包名按名读取或删除动作时，进程内现在把 loader 里存着的同名项也算上；只在内存注册、没有存储的无包动作算"平台的"，和包的动作并存时返回 409。 - 新堵住一个缝：一个包在内存、另一个包只在 loader 时，以前会悄悄挑内存里那个，现在 409 点名两个包。 - 元数据服务里有环境项、旁边有一个停用包时，按名读取现在先答环境项（有环境行）或 409 点名包和平台（无环境行），以前答启用包的动作。 - 按名删除（不带包名）在一个包加一个环境项时只删环境项，和按名读答哪个一致；这个判定现在传给每个 loader 和每个集群节点，所以只存着包动作的存储（制品入口的内存 loader）保留包的动作；以前把包的动作也一起删了。拒绝文案里有非包候选时写 "holders"。 - 风险与回滚：第一方组合里没有和包内动作同名的无包动作，本仓库所有应答不变；代价是裸读命中内存包槽时多读一次 loader。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts -t 32560`，预期 19 例全过（基线上 15 例红）。 Fixes #32560 Clause-②: no (narrowing) — narrowing: `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME)` / `getDiagnosed` of a name a package holds in memory goes from 200 to 409 where a second package holds it only in a loader (it answered the in-memory package's item, a pick between two packages), and where a package-less item no loader stores (the platform's) stands beside the package (it answered the platform's item); the served `GET /meta/action/NAME` and its `/layers` follow where the metadata service's answer reaches them; `MetadataManager.unregister('action', NAME)` beside the platform's item and a package goes from removing both to the same 409. Moved answers (same status, the rule's holder in place of another): the in-process bare read beside one package answers the environment's own item a loader stores (it answered the package's); the served bare read answers the environment's item the metadata service holds beside a disabled package (it answered the enabled package's), and the enabled holder's item where the service holds only a disabled package's customization (it answered that customization); a removal naming no package beside one package removes the environment's own item only, in every store and on every cluster node (it removed the package's action too). Refusals naming a non-package candidate count "holders". The added surface is optional and in-process only: `packagelessOnly` on `MetadataLoaderDeleteOptions` and on the cluster removal payload. Metadata-protocol: none — no key, value or metadata type an author writes changes; what moves is which holder a by-name read or removal naming no package answers or takes, and when it refuses. Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no bare read or removal of an action name a package-less item shares with a package; the prescription ships in the refusal text and the FROM → TO below. ## What changes Step 0 measured each item on #32551's head merged with `main` (#32533 included); seat ruling 6817582700 took every one. Row 6 was added from #32551's third contract review. Contract review r1 (6824229959) F1 is fixed on this head (fix 3 below); F6 corrected the `Clause-②` value; F2–F5 are on follow-up card #32738. This branch is `main` d728d73e6 plus this card (merge section below). | # | state (no package named) | call | FROM | TO | arm | |:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--| | 1 | A on `account` in memory + package-less on `contact` registered only (no loader stores it) | `MetadataManager.get` / `getDiagnosed` | 200 package-less item | 409 `[A, platform]` + "The platform's item binds it to object "contact"" | narrowing | | 1 | same, in the metadata service, no environment row | `GET /meta/action/NAME`, `/layers` | 200 package-less item | 409 `[A, platform]` | narrowing | | 2 | A in memory + the environment's item only in a loader | `MetadataManager.get` / `getDiagnosed` | 200 A | 200 environment's | moved answer | | 2' | A in memory + B only in a loader | `MetadataManager.get` / `getDiagnosed` | 200 A (a pick) | 409 `[A, B]` | narrowing | | 3 | service: A, disabled B, environment on `lead`; registry: A; environment row present | `GET /meta/action/NAME`, `/layers` code layer | 200 A | 200 environment's | moved answer | | 3 | same, no environment row | same | 200 A | 409 `[A, platform]` | narrowing | | 6 | service: the disabled B's slot holds a package-less body (B's customization), no slot of the enabled A; registry: A, disabled B | `GET /meta/action/NAME`, `/layers` code layer | 200 B's customization | 200 A's | moved answer | | 4 | A, B + environment | every refusal | "held by 3 packages" | "held by 3 holders" | wording | | 5a | A, B + environment | `MetadataManager.unregister` (no package) | 409 `[A, B]` | 409 `[A, B, environment]` + its sentence | refusal names every candidate | | 5b | A + environment on another object or object-less, in one store or across stores (the door holding A alone, the rows holding A and the environment's), on every cluster node | `MetadataManager.unregister` (no package), `MemoryLoader` / `DatabaseLoader.delete` | removes both | removes the environment's only (slot, package-less rows); every store holding A keeps it | moved answer | | 5b | A + platform item (registered only) | `MetadataManager.unregister` (no package) | removes both | 409 `[A, platform]`, nothing removed | narrowing | **The fix.** 1. **Registry ∪ loaders (`package-slotted-store.ts`, `metadata-manager.ts`).** `judgesLoaderSlots` says when a read naming no package of an action name must look past the registry: the registry holds a package's slot of the name. `get` and `getDiagnosed` then read the loaders' slots of the name and judge the registry's and the loaders' slots together (`slotViewOf`, which now inherits the registry's write order, so "written last" is unchanged). **Cost:** one `loaderSlotsNamed` per bare action read that hits a package's slot in memory (`DatabaseLoader.loadSlots` reads the type's rows); every other read is unchanged. 2. **Platform vs environment in process.** `platformSlotsOf` calls a package-less registry slot the platform's when no loader stores it on that key (object and name). `readStoreEntry`, `refuseAcrossOwners` and `readIdentity` take those keys: the platform's item beside any package is refused naming `{ kind: 'platform' }`; the environment's answers first beside one package, as before. With a loader failing, no slot is called the platform's (the old reading). 3. **Removal (`storeRemovalKeys`, carried to every store).** Beside one package a removal naming none takes the action name's package-less slots only; the platform's beside a package is refused; beside two packages the refusal names the package-less holder too. The manager judges this over the registry ∪ loaders view, and `storeRemovalKeys` now reports the package-less-only judgment (`packagelessOnly`). [r1 F1] Each loader used to re-judge by its own slots, so a store holding the package's action alone (the artifact door's `MemoryLoader` beside a `DatabaseLoader` holding A's row and the environment's) took A under its one-holder arm, and every cluster peer did the same through `removeNodeLocalCopies`. `unregister` now passes the judgment to each loader's delete (`MetadataLoaderDeleteOptions.packagelessOnly`: `MemoryLoader` and `DatabaseLoader` then delete the name's package-less slots and rows only) and in the cluster removal payload, which a peer hands to the same delete. A payload whose `packagelessOnly` is not `true` (or comes beside a `packageId`) is dropped, as a malformed `packageId` is: read wrongly, it would delete by name. An origin that predates the field sends `{}`, which a peer applies by name, as `main` did. 4. **The service's dropped refusal (`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`, served face).** `rethrowPackageScopedRefusal` now hands back the refusal it drops (fewer than two enabled packages). `judgeDroppedServiceRefusal` judges the package-less item that refusal names, read from the service's list: alone it answers; beside one enabled package it answers when the environment's store holds an active package-less row of it on the same object, and is refused naming the package and the platform otherwise. The plain read's served face and the layered read's code layer use it. 5. **A disabled package's customization (`servedFromDisabledHolder`).** Added from #32551's third review: a package-less service answer fits a judged package holder only when it is not a disabled holder's: the service, asked at each disabled holder the registry names, does not answer the same item. Only read when the judged answer is set and the service's answer is package-less. 6. **Wording (`@objectstack/core`).** `packageScopedRefusalMessage` counts "holders" whenever a candidate is not a package. ## Tests - `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts`, `[#32560]` (11): items 1, 2, 2', 4, 5a, 5b (two shapes, and the platform), CONTROL environment stored beside A, CONTROL platform alone / one package alone, CONTROL one package on two objects answers the one written last over the loaders. - `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`, `[#32560]` (8): with `DatabaseLoader` rows, 5b in two shapes (slot and row of the environment only), 5a refusal with rows untouched, CONTROL one package; [r1 F1] the door + database boot in two shapes (door keeps A, rows keep A, a manager over the door alone answers A), each loader's delete with `packagelessOnly` direct (rows and door keep A's), CONTROL the door holding A alone with no environment item (A removed everywhere, as before). - `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-cluster.test.ts`, `[#32499]` block (11 new): [r1 F1] two nodes, each door holding A's action, the shared store the environment's: a bare removal on node A leaves both doors holding A and both nodes answering A; a removal payload with a non-boolean `packagelessOnly` is dropped (every slotted type, 10). - `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts` (over a real `MetadataManager`): item 3 with and without the environment row, item 1 through the protocol, CONTROL disabled package and the environment alone. The `[#32365]` pins that register "the environment's item" now store it in the service's loader too (an item only registered is the platform's). Runtime also pins row 6. - Red on the base: metadata 11 of 15 red (the 4 CONTROLs green); runtime 3 of 4 red (the CONTROL green); row 6 red with its check removed (it is absent on the base). - [r1 F1] Red before the fix: the five fixed source files put back at the merge `d500fe858` (tests at the fix), match-endpoint + cluster files: 14 failed / 625 passed (the door + database pins ×2, the direct loader pin, the two-node pin, the malformed-payload pin ×10; the CONTROLs green). Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
Ablation (r1 F1), each alone through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored by blob == HEAD Run: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts src/metadata-manager-cluster.test.ts` (639 tests). - `storeRemovalKeys` without `packagelessOnly` (the judgment not carried): 3 failed (door + database ×2, two-node). - `MemoryLoader.delete` ignoring `packagelessOnly`: 4 failed (door + database ×2, direct loader pin, two-node). - `DatabaseLoader.delete` ignoring `packagelessOnly`: 1 failed (direct loader pin). - the peer receipt dropping `packagelessOnly` (only `packageId` carried): 1 failed (two-node). - `receivedRemovalOf` taking only `packagelessOnly === true` (a malformed value read as by-name): 10 failed (malformed payload, every slotted type). - Earlier rounds: `loadSlottedDiagnosed` passing no platform keys → item 1 red; `servedFromDisabledHolder` short-circuited → row 6 red; r1 recorded six more on `a309114bf`.
## Merge with main after #32687 The merge queue ejected `24eb53761` on a conflict with #32687 (`34890e0e7`, per-member keys of bundled types). `main` `d728d73e6` is merged in `e692188f3` (a merge, no rebase); `46c2cab0b` adds one pin. The diff against `main` is now 14 files, 994 changed lines (+903 / −91), under 3000, no governed surface. - **`package-slotted-store.ts`, `readStoreEntry` (textual conflict).** Both kept: `main`'s `keys = found.map((answer) => latestMemberOf(store, answer.key))` (each slot answers its member written last), and this PR's `platformKeys` handed to `refuseAcrossOwners`. - **`metadata-manager.ts`, `slotViewOf` (textual conflict).** Both kept: the registry's keys in `main`'s `latestMembersFirst` order, then the loaders' items from this PR's `loaderStore` argument (both callers already build it with `slotStoreOf`), then this PR's `inheritStoreWriteOrder`. - **`package-slotted-store.ts`, `latestMemberOf` (no textual conflict, a semantic one, fixed inside the merge commit).** `main` answers a view's first member of a slot when the view has no write order; this PR gives the view the registry's write order, so a slot only a loader holds (no member in that order) fell to `writtenLast`'s fallback, the member listed LAST — the older one, since `loadSlots` hands the member written last first. `inheritStoreWriteOrder` now marks the view (`inheritedViews`), and `latestMemberOf` answers such a slot's first member, as `main` does; a slot the registry holds answers by the inherited order, and a real store (registry, `MemoryLoader`) answers exactly as on `main`. - **New pin** (`46c2cab0b`, `metadata-manager-email-template-slot.test.ts`, `[#32517]` block): a loader holding one package's two locales, the registry holding another item of the type — a read naming none and one naming the package answer the member written last. Ablation: the `inheritedViews` line deleted → 1 failed / 1957 passed (that pin); restored, blob == HEAD. - Readings at `46c2cab0b`: `@objectstack/metadata` test 1958 passed (the `[#32560]` and `[#32517]` pins of both sides included), `typecheck` exit 0; `dispatch-gates --commands` 71 derived, every one exit 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 on the first sweep, no full build yet; re-run exit 0; `check:type-check-debt` run under the lock after the dogfood hold, exit 0), `--ran` with exit codes 71/71, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero), 0 UNRUN; `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0; dogfood battery (closure built under the lock) `VERDICT command-exit 0` · 454 files passed / 3 skipped · 3812 tests passed / 42 skipped · 0 failed. `pnpm lint` not re-run locally this round: CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` on this head is the reading. ## Gates At `24eb53761` (`main` cac0f1aab merged in `d500fe858`, the F1 fix on top):

## Shared files with seat 1's chain Trial merges at `a309114bf` (`git merge-tree`), each against the branch's tip then: | branch | shared files | conflicts this branch adds | |:--|:--|:--| | `claude/project-thread-du44hj` (#31700) | `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`, `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`, `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts` | none: the files that conflict are the ones du44hj already conflicts on against `main` | | `claude/project-thread-phk4r9` (#32497) | `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts` | none (phk4r9's own conflicts against `main` are two REST/runtime test files) | | `claude/project-thread-3giljf` | `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts` | none beyond the branch's own against `main` | | `claude/project-thread-wqgmuu` (#31696 PR-3, merged) | none | none | ## Acceptance notes - One package alone, the environment's item alone, the platform's item alone, and every read or removal naming a package answer as before. - No first-party composition has a package-less action under a package's action name, so no answer changes in this repository. - `DatabaseLoader` keeps one row per `(package, name)`; a package-less action written through `register` beside one package's becomes its customization (D4), so the environment-beside-package row shape is pinned by inserting the row directly. - A third-party loader that ignores `packagelessOnly` deletes by its own rule, as every delete did before this field. - Contract review r1 F2–F5 (candidate kind of a removal beside two packages and the platform, the execution face, a loader down, two rare-path costs) are follow-up card #32738, not this PR. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01Utp6CXsZN7qMreCTYFeT5Y
